tools.name: customers_generate_keyword_historical_metrics
tools.description: Returns a list of keyword historical metrics. List of thrown errors: [AuthenticationError]() [AuthorizationError]() [CollectionSizeError]() [HeaderError]() [InternalError]() [QuotaError]() [RequestError](). Required: customerId. Optional: access_token, historicalMetricsOptions, language (plus 5 more).

params.name: customerId
params.description: The ID of the customer with the recommendation.

params.name: access_token
params.description: OAuth access token.

params.name: historicalMetricsOptions
params.description: The options for historical metrics data.

params.name: language
params.description: The resource name of the language to target. Each keyword belongs to some set of languages; a keyword is included if language is one of its languages. If not set, all keywords will be included.

params.name: includeAdultKeywords
params.description: If true, adult keywords will be included in response. The default value is false.

params.name: geoTargetConstants
params.description: The resource names of the location to target. Maximum is 10. An empty list MAY be used to specify all targeting geos.

params.name: keywordPlanNetwork
params.description: Targeting network. If not set, Google Search And Partners Network will be used.

params.name: keywords
params.description: A list of keywords to get historical metrics. Not all inputs will be returned as a result of near-exact deduplication. For example, if stats for 'car' and 'cars' are requested, only 'car' will be returned. A maximum of 10,000 keywords can be used.

params.name: aggregateMetrics
params.description: The aggregate fields to include in response.

tools.name: customers_generate_keyword_ideas

params.name: customerId

params.name: pageToken

params.name: keywordSeed
params.description: A Keyword or phrase to generate ideas from, for example, cars.

params.name: keywordAndUrlSeed
params.description: A Keyword and a specific Url to generate ideas from for example, cars, www.example.com/cars.

params.name: urlSeed
params.description: A specific url to generate ideas from, for example, www.example.com/cars.

params.name: aggregateMetrics

params.name: keywordAnnotation

params.name: language
params.description: The resource name of the language to target. Each keyword belongs to some set of languages; a keyword is included if language is one of its languages. If not set, all keywords will be included.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of results to retrieve in a single page. A maximum of 10,000 results may be returned, if the page_size exceeds this, it is ignored. If unspecified, at most 10,000 results will be returned. The server may decide to further limit the number of returned resources. If the response contains fewer than 10,000 results it may not be assumed as last page of results.
